Defers scheduled payments, easing near-term cash outflows; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Moves the loan maturity from November 30, 2026 to November 30, 2029, reducing near-term repayment pressure.
The CEO and a company director are among the related parties; the company cited exemptions from formal valuation and minority approval requirements.

This is a financing update following previously disclosed transaction-related notes and a shareholder loan, rather than a new operating or earnings disclosure. The next catalyst would be evidence of the company's ability to meet the rescheduled obligations or further updates to its financing terms.
